title: Preserve browser-observed publication timestamps for timing analysis
approved_decision: Use the existing visible time[datetime] attribute as the preferred exact publication-time source; retain raw and normalized values with explicit timezone basis, and add read-only Human Review CSV timing columns.
scope: normalized timing fields and local derivations
fixtures, regression, and bounded HG-03 verification
forbidden: treating relative time text as an exact timestamp
hover or input automation when a direct semantic attribute is available
